record.original_question: Find new mathematical applications of Gronwall lemmas.

evidence.quote: 10. The last two problems With the above considerations in mind look to the following problems: ... Problem 10. Give new applications of the Gronwall lemmas.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Gronwall lemma is, in its classical form, the following statement: if $u,\alpha,\beta:[a,b]\to\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ are continuous functions with $\beta$ nonnegative and
$$u(t)\le \alpha(t)+\int_a^t \beta(s)\,u(s)\,ds\qquad\text{for all }t\in[a,b],$$
then
$$u(t)\le \alpha(t)+\int_a^t \alpha(s)\beta(s)\exp\!\left(\int_s^t \beta(\tau)\,d\tau\right) ds\qquad\text{for all }t\in[a,b].$$
A wide variety of generalizations exist, including discrete versions, nonlinear versions, integral inequalities with weakly singular kernels, multidimensional versions, versions on time scales, stochastic Gronwall inequalities, and abstract Gronwall lemmas formulated in ordered Banach spaces or via fixed-point principles.

Problem. Exhibit genuinely new mathematical applications of Gronwall-type lemmas, i.e., establish results in areas of mathematics (for instance in ordinary or partial differential equations, integral and integro-differential equations, stochastic equations, dynamical systems, control theory, numerical analysis, fractional calculus, or geometric analysis) whose proofs essentially rely on a Gronwall-type inequality, beyond the standard known uses (uniqueness, continuous dependence on data, stability estimates, and a priori bounds for ODEs, PDEs, and their numerical schemes).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is open-ended in nature: it asks for new applications of Gronwall-type inequalities rather than resolution of a single mathematical statement. The literature on Gronwall inequalities continues to grow rapidly, with many new applications appearing (fractional differential equations, stochastic Gronwall lemmas, time scales, etc.), but the meta-problem of producing further new applications has no definitive resolution and is best regarded as a continuing research program.

status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open-ended request for new applications.
